sents.text: Episode two! The bricks are back, and this time, they brought a champion.
The Brick Titan rises from the rubble, stronger than ever.
Orange steps up. He clenches his fists, and powers up!
They blast into the sky. A hundred punches in a single second!
Orange crashes into a hill, but teleports right behind the Titan!
The Titan charges his Brick Blaster. Orange answers with a Stick Beam!
The beams collide, and the whole verse shakes!
One last power up, and the Titan breaks apart!
Who wins episode three? Stick, or Brick? Comment below, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse.
